page.overview.sub: What Dropper is doing right now
page.drops.sub: Everything farmed, claimed and still open
page.campaigns.sub: All drop campaigns on your account
page.stats.sub: Watch time and rewards over time
page.settings.sub: Changes are stored on the server and apply right away
activity.no_channels: No live channel offers your campaigns
banner.offline.title: Connection to Dropper lost
banner.offline.text: The page keeps retrying. Check that the container is running.
banner.failed.text: Twitch refused the claim, usually because a game account is not linked. Dropper keeps retrying on its own.
banner.ready.text: Automatic claiming is switched off, so these wait for you.
banner.error.title: Last error
kpi.failed.sub: Open the Drops tab to see why
why.title: Why this channel?
why.queue: **{campaign}** ({game}) is number **{position}** of **{queue}** in your queue.
why.earlier: The campaigns ahead of it have no live channel right now.
why.rule.single: It is the only one, so the choice was easy.
why.rule.stay: Dropper stays on the current channel while it still counts, so no progress is lost.
why.rule.preferred: It is on your list of preferred channels.
why.rule.acl: This campaign only counts on certain channels, and this is one of them.
why.rule.viewers: Of those, it has the most viewers, which usually means the most stable stream.
why.rule.manual: You picked this channel yourself. Dropper goes back to automatic when it goes offline.
idle.paused.title: Taking a break
idle.paused.text: Farming is paused. Nothing is watched or claimed until you resume.
idle.no_campaigns.title: Nothing to farm right now
idle.no_campaigns.text: No wanted campaign is running. Check your filters or wait for new campaigns.
idle.no_campaigns.watching: No wanted campaign is running. Dropper keeps an eye on the games on your priority list and starts as soon as one of them gets drops.
idle.no_channels.title: Waiting for a stream
idle.no_channels.text: No live channel offers your campaigns right now. Next check {time}.
idle.working.title: Getting things ready
drop.title: Current drop
queue.title: Campaign queue
claims.title: Recently claimed
claims.empty: Nothing claimed yet. Your first drop will show up here.
drops.empty: No drops known yet. They appear after the first campaign refresh.
drops.auto.hint: Change this in Settings under Claiming
drops.failed.title: Twitch refused the claim
drops.failed.link: The game account for this campaign is not linked. Link it and Dropper tries again with the next refresh.
drops.failed.retry: Dropper keeps trying with growing pauses until the claim window closes.
history.title: Claim history
collection.title: Reward collection
collection.empty: Your inventory is empty so far
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. They load right after the login.
campaigns.source.catalog: Twitch no longer shows apps the full campaign list, so Dropper takes it from the public ttvdrops catalog and reads the drops from the live channels that offer them.
campaigns.source.inventory: Twitch no longer shows apps the full campaign list and the catalog is not reachable, so only campaigns you already started appear here.
camp.nodetails: Drop details appear as soon as a live channel offers this campaign.
skip.not_prioritized: Game not on the priority list
skip.badges_off: Only badges or emotes, which are switched off
skip.unavailable: No drop can be earned right now
channels.manual.hint: Watch any channel by hand. Dropper goes back to automatic when it goes offline.
channels.dropson.hint: Twitch marks this stream as drops enabled. Its exact campaigns are checked once it becomes a candidate.
channels.empty: No channels yet. They are searched once the campaigns are loaded.
set.account.connected: Logged in with a device code
set.account.none: Log in with the code shown on screen
set.account.hint: Dropper never sees your password. You log in like on a TV: confirm a code on twitch.tv/activate. The session is kept in the data folder.
set.auto_claim.hint: When off, finished drops wait for the Claim button in the Drops tab.
set.points.hint: Grabs the bonus chest on the channel being watched
set.sweep.hint: How often Dropper looks for finished drops that are not claimed yet
set.refresh.hint: How often campaigns and channels are reloaded from Twitch
set.webhook.hint: In Discord: Server Settings › Integrations › Webhooks › Copy Webhook URL. Other URLs receive JSON.
set.notify.name: Name
set.notify.name.hint: Shown as the sender in Discord. Leave empty for Dropper.
set.notify.name.bad: Discord does not allow names with “discord” or “clyde”, nor “everyone” or “here”.
set.notify.avatar.hint: Square images work best. Without one, Dropper uses its icon, unless the webhook already has a picture from Discord.
set.notify.avatar.bad: This file could not be read as an image
set.notify.claimed.hint: With the reward and how far the campaign is
set.notify.failed.hint: Once per drop, with the reason from Twitch
set.notify.campaign_done.hint: Every drop of a campaign is claimed
set.notify.watched.hint: A game on your priority list gets a campaign, also before it starts
set.notify.new_campaign.hint: A campaign you farm has just started
set.notify.login.hint: The Twitch login expired and farming waits for you
set.priority.empty: No games yet. Add one below, with or without a running campaign.
set.priority.hint: Games on this list are farmed first, from top to bottom. Add any game, even one without drops right now: Dropper starts as soon as it gets a campaign.
game.missing: Not found on Twitch. Check the spelling.
game.nomatch: No Twitch game with exactly this name
set.mode.ending_soonest.hint: Campaigns that end first are farmed first. A good default.
set.mode.low_availability.hint: Campaigns with the least time to spare come first: time left compared with the watch time still needed.
set.mode.priority_only.hint: Only games on the priority list are farmed, in list order. Everything else is skipped.
set.badges.hint: They need no linked game account, so they always arrive
set.linked: Skip campaigns without a linked account
set.linked.hint: In-game items can only be delivered to a linked game account
set.preferred.hint: Picked first whenever they offer a wanted campaign
set.languages.hint: Only streams in these languages, for example en or de. Leave empty for all.
set.per_game.hint: How many drops-enabled streams are fetched from each game directory
set.verify.hint: Asks Twitch which campaigns each candidate channel really offers
set.catalog.hint: Public list of running campaigns. Dropper needs it because Twitch hides the full list from apps. Leave empty to turn it off.
set.proxy.hint: Optional HTTP proxy for all Twitch traffic
set.gql.hint: Only needed when Twitch changes its API before Dropper is updated. A JSON object mapping operation names to sha256 hashes.
login.title: Connect your Twitch account
login.text: Dropper logs in like a TV app. You never enter your password here.
login.error: Twitch did not hand out a code
login.note: The session is kept in the data folder, so you only do this once.
modal.logout.title: Log out of Twitch?
modal.logout.text: Dropper stops farming until you log in again with a new code.
notify.campaign_done.text: Every drop of this campaign is claimed.
notify.watched.upcoming: A new campaign is coming up. Dropper farms it once it starts.
notify.watched.active: A new campaign is running. Dropper farms it in the order of your priority list.
notify.watched.link: A new campaign is running. Link your game account so Dropper can farm it.
notify.login.text: The Twitch login expired. Open Dropper and enter the new code at twitch.tv/activate. Farming waits until then.
notify.test.text: Dropper notifications will show up here.
toast.claim_failed.text: Twitch refused it. The reason is shown on the drop.
toast.notify_test.text: Have a look at your Discord channel.
toast.gql_invalid: The hash overrides are not valid JSON
